 prime, then `a**(p-1) ≡ 1 mod p`. As a consequence, we have `a * a**(p-2) ≡ 1 mod p`, which means that
 `a**(p-2)` is the modular multiplicative inverse of a in Fp.

@title LendingPool
 @author TrustLend Team
 @notice Core lending contract for TrustLend, a decentralised micro-lending
         platform on Polygon Amoy. It manages pool liquidity, borrower loans,
         trust-score-gated limits, interest and automatic scoring on repayment.
 @dev Pool accounting (shares)
  - Lenders own shares of the pool. Pool value = free liquidity + principal on loan.
  - Repaid interest raises the pool value. Each share is then worth more (lender yield).
  - A default removes the unpaid principal from the pool value. All lenders share the loss.
  - Tokens sent straight to the contract are NOT counted. They cannot be claimed as yield.
    Use depositToPool() to add liquidity, or addRecovery() to add value for all lenders.
 @dev Loan rules
  - One active loan per borrower. A defaulted loan must be repaid before a new loan.
  - A new wallet starts at INITIAL_SCORE on its first loan request.
  - A wallet with a score below MIN_BORROW_SCORE cannot borrow.
  - A repayment inside MIN_BONUS_AGE of the loan start gives no score bonus.
  - markDefault() works only after the due date.

@title  ReputationNFT
 @author TrustLend Team
 @notice Soulbound (non-transferable) ERC-721 NFT representing each user's
         on-chain credit identity within the TrustLend ecosystem.
 @dev    Architecture overview
   ┌──────────────┐  mintReputationNFT()   ┌─────────────────┐
   │ LendingPool  │ ──────────────────────▶ │  ReputationNFT  │
   │  (trusted)   │  updateReputation()     │  (Soulbound)    │

                                                    │

 Key properties:
  • One NFT per wallet — enforced on mint.
  • Fully non-transferable — all ERC-721 transfer/approval entry-points revert.
  • Only the designated LendingPool address can update scores.
  • 100 % on-chain metadata — JSON + SVG art encoded as base64 data URIs.
  • Tier ladder: Entry (30-39) → Bronze (40-59) → Silver (60-79) → Gold (80-100).

@title VouchSystem
 @notice Peer vouching: users stake tokens to back a borrower's credibility.
 Flow:
  1. The voucher approves this contract to spend their tokens.
  2. The voucher calls stakeForBorrower(). The tokens lock in this contract.
  3. The borrower repays in full. LendingPool calls settleBorrower(borrower, false). Stakes return.
  4. The borrower defaults. LendingPool calls settleBorrower(borrower, true). Stakes go to the treasury.
  5. The borrower has no active loan. The voucher can take the stake back with reclaimStake().
 The owner can still call releaseStake() and slashStake() for manual cases.
@notice Smallest stake accepted (1 TRUST).
@notice Most unsettled vouches one borrower can have. This bounds the loops.

Inheriting from `ReentrancyGuard` will make the {nonReentrant} modifier available, which can be applied to functions to make sure there are no nested (reentrant) calls to them.
